note: Font contract. 'required' is what the design system is specified against. 'substitution' is the explicitly declared fallback profile; it is never applied silently - every artifact records that it was used.

substitution.reason: Cormorant Garamond and Manrope are unobtainable in this environment: the egress proxy denies fonts.googleapis.com and the npm registry, so neither the font files nor a font package can be fetched.

500.note: Instrument Serif has no Medium; resolves to Regular.

600.note: Instrument Serif has no SemiBold; resolves to Regular.

500.note: Instrument Sans has no Medium; resolves to Regular.

600.note: Instrument Sans has no SemiBold; resolves to Bold.
